title: FIRST AMENDMENT TO AGREEMENT NO. 26-10193 WITH ACCENTURE LLP AND THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES HARBOR DEPARTMENT FOR THE WORKDAY EXTENDED SUPPORT FOR CONTINUED OPTIMIZATION OF THE HUMAN RESOURCES AND PAYROL
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - FIRST AMENDMENT TO AGREEMENT NO. 26-10193 WITH ACCENTURE LLP AND THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES HARBOR DEPARTMENT FOR THE WORKDAY EXTENDED SUPPORT FOR CONTINUED OPTIMIZATION OF THE HUMAN RESOURCES AND PAYROLL SYSTEM
Transmittal 1
Transmittal 2
Summary
: Staff requests approval of the First Amendment to Agreement No. 26-10193 with Accenture LLP (Accenture). This proposed Amendment will extend the term for one year with an option of an additional year, expand the scope of work, and add $271,728 in annual compensation for the expanded scope of work. This Agreement is in alignment with Strategic Objective 3: Improved Financial Performance of Port Assets. The City of Los Angeles (City) Harbor Department (Harbor Department) has been using two Accenture consultants, one full and one half-time, to address existing and anticipated Workday issues. The additional half-time consultant will provide support for issues affecting Workday payroll functions. While previous Workday issues have been resolved, additional new issues and transaction corrections have been identified and require continued support from Workday consultants. The consulting services remain necessary to provide post-implementation support for Workday. Accenture consultants provide Workday support services to the Harbor Department by managing critical human resources and payroll issues affecting Harbor Department employees. They also provide technical Workday support to update configurations, resolve issues, and implement enhancements. In addition, the Accenture consultants provide project management, stakeholder management, change management, training, testing support, and functional expertise for Harbor Department staff. The Harbor Department will continue to be financially responsible for the payment of expenses incurred under the Agreement.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is administratively exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II, Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) find that in accordance with Los Angeles City Charter Section 1022, work under the subject agreement can be performed more feasibly by independent contractors than by City employees; 3) approve the proposed First Amendment to Agreement No. 26-10193 with Accenture LLP to extend the term for one year with an option of an additional year, expand the scope of work, and increase compensation under Agreement No. 26-10193 to $1,087,728 per year, including related expenses; 4) authorize the Executive Director to execute and the Board Secretary to attest to the proposed First Amendment to Agreement No. 26-10193 for and on behalf of the Board; and 5) adopt Resolution No. ___________.
